question.text:
Among the statement (I – IV), the correct ones are:

(I) Be has smaller atomic radius compared to Mg.

(II) Be has higher ionization enthalpy than AI.

(III) Charge/radius ratio of Be is greater than that of Al.

(IV) Both Be and Al form mainly covalent compounds

solution.text: Charge/radius ratio of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Be</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Al</mi></math> is same because of diagonal relationship. Remaining statements are correct.
